name: Gerk's uncle
slug: Gerk's uncle, the Grunkle, who died after taking Ord's strength.
description: Gerk's uncle, called the Grunkle. He died at the end of a battle with the party after taking some of Ord's strength.

log.summary: The party recalled the fight with the Grunkle, which ended in his death after he took some of Ord's strength. A floating Ord appeared and, with Dana involved, solidified into a runic bead or rune-marked sphere. Sylan first remembered the uncle punching the strength out of Gerk. The strength is hidden in Gerk.
notes: Called the Grunkle. His battle with the party ended in his death.

During that fight he took some of Ord's strength. A floating Ord appeared and solidified into a runic bead or rune-marked sphere, with Dana involved in that moment. Sylan first remembered it as the uncle punching the strength out of Gerk. The strength is hidden in Gerk.
